sections.description:
PUNJAB PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
PUNJAB PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
SERVICE RULES, 2003
(Amendment of Scheds.)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
26th December, 2012]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-9)2003,
dated 15-8-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the
Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to direct that in the Punjab Public Service Commission Service Rules,
2003, the following amendment shall be made:
In
the said Rules, in the Schedule, at Sr. No.6-C, in column No.5, for the
existing entry, the following shall be substituted:
"(i) Master's
Degree (first division or grade-B) in Computer Science or Information
Technology or four years Bachelor's Degree (first division or grade-B) in
Computer Science or Information Technology from a HEC recognized University;
(ii) five
years' experience in the field of Electronic Data Processing or IT or System
Analysis or Computer Programming or administration of Database including at
least 3 years experience as Database Administrator; and
(iii) certified
Database Administrator preferably Oracle certified."
